content: The full SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT TV anime will begin in January 2027 with a total of eight episodes, with a new key visual revealed. title: Norimitsu Kaihō, Kurageso's Akarui Mirai Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Thursday that Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso's Akarui Mirai manga will end in the next issue on October 23. Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025.
author: ANN

title: Hollywood’s First Live-Action Webtoon Series in the Works With Charlize Theron & Hulu
content: Manhwa and webtoons have become absolutely massive within pop culture spaces in the past few years, with series like Lore Olympus , Solo Leveling , and Heartstopper becoming popular enough to receive televisio adaptations as well as merchandise and physical publications of their source materials.
author: ComicBook

title: Hotel Inhumans Anime's 2nd Season Casts Shōya Chiba
content: The official website for the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga revealed on Thursday a new cast member for the anime's second season . The website also began streaming a preview video for the first episode of the new season (episode 14 overall), but it is not currently available in the U.S.
author: ANN

title: Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia Manga Miniseries Ends in Next Chapter
content: This year's 43rd issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Thursday Hiro Mashima 's Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia manga miniseries will end in the next chapter in the 44th issue on September 30. The miniseries launched in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on July 29.

title: Ani-One Asia Licenses Hotel Inhumans Season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2, The Vermillion Mask Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it has licensed the Hotel Inhumans season 2, Reincarnated as a Sword season 2, The Vermillion Mask , Vertex Force , and Uncle’s Obsession with Cute Things anime. All five anime will debut in October.
author: ANN

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Reborn as a Space Mercenary, Magical Explorer Anime
content: Aniplus Asia announced on Tuesday and Wednesday that it will air simulcasts of the Reborn as a Space Mercenary and Magical Explorer anime for the fall 2026 anime season. The television anime of Ryūto and Tetsuhiro Nabeshima 's Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals First Trailer, January 2027 Release Date
content: Now That We Draw anime revealed the first teaser trailer, along with new character visuals and a January 2027 release date. Shunsuke Ishikawa is directing the anime at studio ROLL2, with Deko Akao handling the series composition and Hiromi Nakagawa as the character designer.
author: Anime Corner

title: WEBTOON Launches 1st Global Drop With The Warrior's Ballad
content: WEBTOON Entertainment has launched its first "Global Drop" project with The Warrior's Ballad , releasing the fantasy webtoon simultaneously in nine languages on September 19.
